senses.meaning: Cơn tuyết/mưa/gió ngắn và nhẹ; sự bùng phát ngắn của hoạt động
examples: A brief flurry of snow dusted the rooftops overnight.
There was a flurry of activity in the office before the deadline.
We saw a flurry of questions from the audience after the talk.

note: Hai cách dùng phổ biến: (1) thời tiết — cơn tuyết/mưa nhẹ; (2) nghĩa rộng — sự ồn ào/bùng phát ngắn ('a flurry of activity').

senses.meaning: Trận mưa lớn; trận lụt; lượng lớn áp đảo
examples: The city was hit by a sudden deluge that flooded the streets.
The company received a deluge of complaints after the announcement.
A deluge of requests crashed the website on launch day.

senses.meaning: Tràn ngập, áp đảo bằng lượng lớn (thường thụ động)
examples: The support team was deluged with calls after the outage.
She was deluged with questions from journalists.
Fans deluged the star with letters and gifts.

senses.meaning: Hạn hán, thời kỳ thiếu mưa kéo dài
examples: The drought has devastated crops across the region.
A severe drought left millions without clean water.
The lake nearly dried up during the two-year drought.
The humidity in the jungle made it hard to breathe.
High humidity levels make hot weather feel even more oppressive.
The museum controls temperature and humidity to preserve its artworks.

senses.meaning: Đợt sóng lớn; đám khói/mây cuồn cuộn
examples: Billows of smoke poured from the burning building.
The sails caught the wind in great billows.
A billow of steam rose from the factory chimney.

senses.meaning: Phồng lên, cuồn cuộn (khói, vải, mây)
examples: The curtains billowed in the summer breeze.
Smoke billowed from the factory chimney all day.
Her dress billowed out around her as she danced.

senses.meaning: (Không khí) trong lành, se lạnh và dễ chịu; (đồ ăn) giòn; (văn phong/hành động) gọn gàng, dứt khoát
examples: We went for a walk in the crisp autumn air.
A crisp winter morning greeted us as we stepped outside.
The biscuit had a satisfying crisp texture.

note: 'Crisp' có ít nhất 3 nghĩa thường gặp: (1) không khí se lạnh trong lành; (2) thức ăn giòn rụm; (3) cách trình bày/lời nói gọn gàng, sắc bén.
